sshReviewR1.summary:
What this change does: [PR #9](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/moonbase/pull/9) adds scoped SSH forwarding and authenticated host-health verification through the shared application service. **Three must-fix findings remain.**

1. **[P1] Early Disconnect leaves Connect pending indefinitely** — [index.ts:119](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/packages/ssh/src/index.ts:119). Calling Disconnect from the first `connecting` observation completes teardown with zero children, but the original Connect never settles. The attempt can be interrupted before its finalizer installs; nothing then completes `g.ready`. Settle pending waiters from the owning release path, including attempts that never started.

2. **[P1] Host-authentication bypass settings pass preflight** — [index.ts:157](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/packages/ssh/src/index.ts:157). Actual system `ssh -G` output with `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` plus `NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost=yes` is accepted. macOS’s `NoHostAuthenticationForProxyCommand=yes` also passes. These disable host authentication; application health does not replace SSH verification. Reject enabled bypass flags before forwarding. [OpenSSH documentation](https://man.openbsd.org/ssh_config#NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost)

3. **[P2] SSH exit can leave a stale endpoint and surviving proxy helper** — [process.ts:30](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/packages/ssh/src/process.ts:30). Exit is recorded only on `close`, which waits for inherited stdio. A helper holding stderr keeps status `connected` and endpoint lookup available after SSH dies; Disconnect then signals the dead PID and fails cleanup. Reproduced with controlled forwarding and actual system SSH using a pipe-only ProxyCommand. Separate exit detection from pipe drainage and scope cleanup to the owned process group. [Node event semantics](https://nodejs.org/api/child_process.html#event-close)

Reviewed exact commits:

- **HEAD:** `d1a28745362c5f9cf5c164f3ef19fc8ac8af983b`
- **BASE:** `09b21f2ee8556c54ef4f8238f0be2ee88fd990c3`

The 25 SSH and 29 application tests pass. Independent probes reproduce all three defects; typecheck, foundation checks and the 253-input dependency audit pass. Prior #6 health and #8 contract dispositions remain intact. No tracked files changed. PRs #1, #2, #5, #6, #8 and #9 are linked, without watches.

[Full report](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/test-results/review-task06/REPORT.txt) · [Runnable repros](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/test-results/review-task06/review.test.ts) · [Results](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-158cbcd0/test-results/review-task06/final-independent-tests.log)

chatContractReviewR1.summary:
What this change does: [PR #10](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/moonbase/pull/10) adds browser-safe chat contracts and shared Effect dispatch, plus requirements for durable admission and authenticated RPC.

**No blocking findings at the reviewed head. Contract cleared for downstream implementation.**

- **HEAD:** `d38833db81c5d97a1aa60f25e0dc27dd670af60f`
- **BASE:** `09b21f2ee8556c54ef4f8238f0be2ee88fd990c3` — `chore/connection-contract`, PR #8.
- Verified private `ejjsharpe/moonbase`, the supplied Moonbase project binding, assigned worktree, exact ancestry, and unchanged tracked files. PRs #1, #2, #5, #6, #8 and #10 are linked to this thread.

The coordinator’s replay objection is addressed **in the specification**: server-issued grants expire, are consumed atomically before dispatch, and cannot survive restart or authorize a second RPC. Signed request bodies, response bodies/status, separate proof domains, and authentication before input disclosure cover the identified failure scenario. This follows the verifier-enforced replay protection principle described in [RFC 9421 §7.2.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9421.html#section-7.2.2).

I inspected the installed published Pi Durable 1.4.0 APIs and admission implementation. The contract correctly accounts for ordinary two-phase submission, weaker Pi deduplication, read-only admission lookup, queued withdrawal, and changing task IDs. Captured Stop targets never authorize adopting a successor or later input.

Validation passed:

- Frozen dependency installation; uncached Nx typecheck, lint and tests.
- Foundation checks: 40 frozen source hashes, UI copies and four isolated browser contracts; `git diff --check`.
- Five fresh, typechecked [public-interface probes](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-355adc48/.review-pr10/probe.test.ts): nullable receipts, queued Stop forwarding, combined capability/runtime sharing, nonblocking Stop, cancellation, acquisition/disposal races and retained uncertainty.
- Both hosted CI jobs were successful at the exact head.

The probe file is untracked; production source was not edited.

Not checked: production Pi/SQLite admission, HTTP authentication, Stop races, remote/provider execution, packaging or manual acceptance. Those remain pending implementation gates; fixture success does not qualify them.

What this change does: [PR #11](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/moonbase/pull/11) combines the reviewed editor/workspace modules and adds real integration tests. **One blocking finding remains.**

   Reproduction: Save A commits but loses its reply; Save B commits; retry A. B’s receipt encounters a revision gap and is discarded. A’s retry cannot bridge the remaining gap. Further recovery writes and Quit fail, leaving subsequent edits outside persisted recovery.

sshReviewR2.summary:
What this change does: [PR #9](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/moonbase/pull/9) adds scoped SSH forwarding and authenticated host verification. **One must-fix finding remains.**

1. **[P2] Normal macOS teardown can fail and block reconnect** — [process.ts:74](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-c85d195c/packages/ssh/src/process.ts:74). Immediately after SIGTERM, the owned group can briefly return `EPERM` before disappearing. The code treats this as permanent failure: Disconnect rejects, status remains `disconnecting`, and Connect conflicts until release is retried. Retry this ambiguous observation within the existing deadline, while preserving errors for persistent failures and requiring confirmed cleanup. [Apple’s implementation](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/main/bsd/kern/kern_sig.c#L1612-L1621) supports this exit-window behavior.

R1 dispositions:

- **Early Disconnect:** resolved; all 12 coalesced waiters settle with zero children.
- **Host-authentication bypass flags:** resolved; actual `ssh -G` enabled cases reject and disabled controls pass.
- **Exit versus inherited pipes:** original defect resolved; cleanup clearance remains blocked by finding 1.

Fresh evidence: the initial uninstrumented suite failed this teardown case (**69/70 passed**). Separate reruns passed **41 SSH + 29 application tests**, and **19 independent probes** passed. Passive syscall logging reproduced the new failure in 10/10 trials; 100 uninstrumented timing controls passed. This is intermittent, not universal. Typecheck, lint, build diagnostics, foundation and bundle audit passed.

- **BASE:** `09b21f2ee8556c54ef4f8238f0be2ee88fd990c3`

review-pi-r1.summary:
What this change does: [PR #12](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/moonbase/pull/12) adds the independent Pi chat host, bounded views, exact-task Stop and authenticated remote client.

**Verdict: fix both findings before implementation approval.**

1. **P1 — Unauthenticated requests can obtain trusted RPC errors** — [server.ts:53](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-a948b3bf/packages/pi-runtime/src/server.ts:53).
   
   Validation failures are signed before authentication/grant consumption. Using only observed nonce/challenge headers, an active relay can obtain a genuine signed `InvalidInput` response—even after the challenge was consumed—and substitute it for a successful reply. I reproduced this through the production remote client: creation persisted, and Send was admitted and executed, while both appeared rejected.
   
   **Fix:** sign application errors only after successful authentication and atomic grant consumption; return generic unsigned failures earlier. Otherwise, authenticated responses can misrepresent executed work.

2. **P2 — Committed creation is reported as definite failure** — [index.ts:55](/Users/elliotsharpe/.t3/worktrees/moonbase/t3-a948b3bf/packages/pi-runtime/src/index.ts:55).
   
   `createChat` commits before reading metadata for its reply, but unknown creation failures become `Persistence`. Injecting failure into that public read after a real SQLite commit produced `Persistence`; matching retry recovered the saved conversation.
   
   **Fix:** retain `Uncertain` once creation may have committed. Otherwise, callers can abandon the original request and create duplicates.
